items.exampleEn: Could you go over my report before I send it?
items.exampleZh: 我寄出報告之前，你可以幫我檢查一下嗎？

items.exampleEn: We have an hour here, so let's look around.
items.exampleZh: 我們在這裡有一個小時，到處看看吧。

items.exampleEn: I always mix their names up.
items.exampleZh: 我總是搞混他們的名字。

items.exampleEn: Tom paid back the money last month.
The police officer asked the driver to pull the car over.
items.exampleZh: 警察要求司機靠邊停車。

items.exampleEn: She is saving up for a new bike.
items.exampleZh: 她正在存錢買一台新腳踏車。

items.exampleEn: We went to the airport to see Grandpa off.
items.exampleZh: 我們去機場為爺爺送行。

items.sentenceEn: Pull over here. I want to buy some water.
items.sentenceZh: 在這裡靠邊停一下，我想買點水。

items.audioEn: I'm saving up because I want to travel to Japan next summer.
items.audioZh: 我在存錢，因為我明年夏天想去日本旅行。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼在存錢？
options: To pay for a music class

items.sentenceEn: Sorry, I mixed up the times of the two trains.
items.sentenceZh: 抱歉，我把兩班火車的時間搞混了。

items.sentenceEn: We looked around the shop but didn't buy anything.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在店裡四處看了看，但什麼也沒買。

items.stemEn: Before the test, I ____ my notes one more time to remember everything.
items.stemZh: 考試前，我把筆記再複習一次，好把內容都記住。

items.stemEn: The whole school stood outside to ____ the team before the big game.
items.stemZh: 大賽前，全校的人站在外面為球隊送行。

items.passageEn: Last summer, our uncle Ben visited us and drove my sister and me to the mountains. On the way, he pulled over in a small town so we could look around. We found a little shop that sold bags made by hand. My sister had saved up for months, so she bought one. Uncle Ben set off for home two days later, and we stood outside the house to see him off.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，Ben 叔叔來看我們，開車載我和我的姊妹去山上。途中，他在一個小鎮靠邊停車，讓我們四處看看。我們找到一家賣手工包包的小店。我的姊妹已經存了好幾個月的錢，所以買了一個。兩天後 Ben 叔叔出發回家，我們站在屋外為他送行。

questions.questionZh: 叔叔為什麼在小鎮停車？
作者的姊妹怎麼有錢買包包？

items.promptZh: 我會在星期五前把錢還給你。
referenceEn: I will pay you back before Friday.
I'll pay you back by Friday.
I'm going to pay the money back before Friday.
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 pay you back、pay back the money 等；代名詞受詞放中間（pay you back）
不用片語但意思正確（例如 return the money、give you the money back 等）也算對
用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to 等）
「在星期五前」可寫，例如 before Friday、by Friday 等

items.promptZh: 老師上課前和我們一起複習了這一課。
referenceEn: Our teacher went over the lesson with us before class.
Before class, our teacher went over the lesson with us.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 went over the lesson 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 reviewed the lesson 等）也算對
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 went over、has gone over 等）
「上課前」可放句首或句尾（例如 before class 等）
